producer_commit.message_summary: Frida Desktop GUI: semantic ontology + test harness + React dashboard + Android app [DOCUMENTED_PARTIAL]

semantic_ontology.role: test structure definition + RFL component mapping

gradle_build.role: Build orchestration (not validated by full compile)

falsifiers_discovered.description: CI compilation incomplete: only MainActivity.java compiled; ResearchModePanel, RFLBridge, MetricsPoller, React frontend, backend server, and test harness NOT built
falsifiers_discovered.evidence: GitHub Actions android-build.yml ran successfully but artifact manifest shows only MainActivity.class

falsifiers_discovered.description: RFLBridge.java JNI corruption: duplicate method signatures; native wrappers call themselves recursively
falsifiers_discovered.evidence: Source code inspection shows setMode(), snapshot(), predict(), train(), reset() defined twice with conflicting JNI export

falsifiers_discovered.description: ResearchModePanel not linked to MainActivity; missing imports, @BindView annotations, onCreate() integration, AndroidX configuration
falsifiers_discovered.evidence: ResearchModePanel.java exists but not referenced in MainActivity; build would fail if CI ran full compilation

falsifiers_discovered.description: Frontend infrastructure missing: no index.html, main.tsx, tsconfig.json; 'Vite started' does not prove build or rendering
falsifiers_discovered.evidence: Dashboard files created but React entry point bootstrap incomplete; dev server port 5173 opened but no artifact validation

falsifiers_discovered.description: Test harness uses synthetic metrics: sleep() calls and fake data generation produce PASS without physical device or Frida runtime
falsifiers_discovered.evidence: test_runner.py contains sleep(0.1) and generate_synthetic_metrics() functions; no device_validation_marker in results

falsifiers_discovered.description: No post-merge receipt: commit chain exists (4f9285 → 341f457 → fce522d) but no federated receipt linking artifact identity, schema, and authority
falsifiers_discovered.evidence: Mapa/data/control-plane/ has no frida-desktop entry; no lineage_id or dedup rule defined

falsifiers_discovered.description: Cross-repository branch 'synchronized across 10 repos' is TOKEN_VAZIO: no manifest with repo/ref/SHA-256 exists in Mapa
falsifiers_discovered.evidence: Branch claude/gui-testes-resultados-6k8yzp claimed on 10 repos but Mapa/data/control-plane/ has no registry entry

falsifiers_discovered.description: Gap categorization imprecise: audit lists '12 TOKEN_VAZIO across 6 categories' without individual IDs; two additional global blockers (device execution, TOROID topology) untracked
falsifiers_discovered.evidence: OBSERVACAO-FINAL.md enumerates TV-CODE (2), TV-TEST (2), TV-DATA (2), TV-INDEPENDENCE (2), TV-BOUNDARY (1), TV-ACCESS (1) = 10; device + TOROID = 2 additional, unindexed

epistemological_errors.error: Promoted 'code exists' (IMPLEMENTED) to 'untested in declared scope' (IMPLEMENTED_UNTESTED) globally, ignoring CI-level failures
epistemological_errors.correction: Reclassified as DOCUMENTED_PARTIAL / PARTIAL_FAIL_CLOSED; compilation must close before IMPLEMENTED promotion

epistemological_errors.error: CI green on one file (MainActivity.java) interpreted as 'all files compile'
epistemological_errors.correction: CI green on subset ≠ all targets green; require full compilation including Java, native, React, backend

epistemological_errors.error: 'Harness PASS' from synthetic metrics interpreted as physical evidence
epistemological_errors.correction: Synthetic PASS ≠ device evidence; harness must require device=true or TOKEN_VAZIO marker

epistemological_errors.error: Vite dev server started → React/backend built or functional
epistemological_errors.correction: Dev server ≠ build artifact; require npm run build output, test-drive dashboard, validate API contract
